quote.author: Gina Mizell
quote.text:
Jabari Walker knows he is doing his job when he starts to hear “little slick comments” like this during a game: 

“Man, stop crashing.” 

“I can’t box you out.” 

The Sixers’ depleted frontcourt needs all the help it can get right now.
